snapshot.content: Canonical repo source: documentation/architecture/book-editor-authoring-modal-architecture.md. Current contract: normal Open Book stays on /lobby and opens BookEditorModal; tabs are exactly Overview, Content, Settings; Content uses a left outline navigator and right selected-item workspace; row actions use a real document.body-portaled menu; compact right-panel actions use SVG icon buttons; active-tab save flushes dirty cross-tab edits; neutral/violet modal chrome and restrained typography replace legacy teal/green and over-bold styling. Targeted verification: 6 files / 62 tests passing on 2026-06-06.
